notes.title: Watarcade 1.12.3 (Pegfall update)
notes.notes:
- Pegfall as been added to Atlantis. Good luck.
- Atlantis games now make noises when changing bets

notes.title: Watarcade 1.12.2 (Roulette Update)
notes.notes:
[h2]Atlantis[/h2]
[list]
[*]Now has specific soundtracks that play in the background.
[*]Blackjack shouldn’t let you play after the dealer leaves now.
[*]Roulette has been added.
[/list]
[h2]Fish Tank[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now have up to fish 6 tanks. Yeah, I said it: fish. 
[*]Also made the fish options a little better. What’s that mean? Stuff closes when you hit buttons, or flavor text is different.
[*]Hexagons are now purchasable.
[*]Darker rocks are now purchasable.
[*]You can now tap the glass by right clicking. It makes your fish run from wherever you tap.
[*][b]If there are any issues with transferring fish (example: they're missing), comment on this and I'll explain recovery.[/b] 
[/list]
[h2]Pinball Cove[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shaking now shakes the entire board a tad, also has sound. No more shaking while paused.
[*]Gameover now has text on screen to say it’s over.
[*]The ball is heavier.
[*]Catching the ball with the flippers is easier.
[/list]
[h3]Marine Survey[/h3]
[list]
[*]Assigning anomalies now includes which one you want to appear.
[/list]
[h3]Flow Connections[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the transition animation when losing in time trial.
[*]Now makes some beeps when you are low on time.
[/list]
[h3]Puzzle Reef[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now makes some boops when you are low on time.
[/list]
[h3]Aqua Shuffle[/h3]
[list]
[*]Something interesting happens when you are low on time.
[/list]
[h3]Sea Smash[/h3]
[list]
[*]Player explosions now have sounds.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*]High Scores menu now has manual selection.
[*]Removed the “powerups will be [enabled/disabled]” buttons. I don’t think it has been necessary for a year.
[*]Lastly, I never thought I’d say this, but buttons should make noises. 
[/list]

notes.title: Watarcade 1.12.1 (The Blackjack update)
notes.notes:
[h2]Bubble Wall[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the timing with the guess animation/sound. Also made it change with board size.
[*] Kinda felt like the points in this were an afterthought, so I decided to add a new mechanic. Hitting targets in an ascending or descending order now awards more points. This is also reflected in the instructions now.
[*] Removed a dev cheat.
[/list]
[h2]Atlantis[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new “SLAM!!!” mechanic has been added so that you can express how you feel while gambling. Just express yourself responsibly.
[*] [h1][i][u][b]Blackjack[/b][/u][/i][/h1] has been added. It’s got a couple varying rules and even some dapper dealers.

[*] The Wheel’s spin button has been recolored
[*] Slots got some more visual and audio updates
[/list]

Go wild, you can play [h1][i][u][b]Blackjack.[/b][/u][/i][/h1] Do you need anything else?
